meta.name: QQ Coffee · the site system
meta.title: One fluid size system for home, catalog and 25 coffee pages; round 2: a navbar on grounds, the hero in rows
meta.lede: The whole system of the QQ Coffee site: 33 size roles drawn as lines from a 320 to a 1440 screen, three shared layout steps and the column at its most, one colour table with one line colour, one motion vocabulary, the 3D packs. Round 2 rebuilt the navbar (four steps, the colours of the section under it, a tab bar on phones) and the hero (screen less 24, three shared rows, a countdown as wide as its caption), made every line one colour, and the packs trail and press. Measured at every 10px of width and 25px of height; «before» is round 1's build.
meta.footer: Measured in headless Chromium on the built sites, 2026-10-20. Before = round 1 (branch component-canvas, commit 6673a8f); now = branch round-2. Round 1's «before» was the Figma frames.

blocks.label: What it looks like
blocks.note: Round 1 in grey, round 2 in blue, at the size each caption names. Click a picture to open it large; arrows and Escape work.

items.title: Navbar at 1440
items.text: No lines between the groups (16px of air instead); the profile icon added; the bar's own margin is the small 16px; colours of the section under it (black over the hero).

items.title: Navbar hover at 1440
items.text: Before: the other links dimmed to 60%. After: only the item under the pointer changes, a white tint at 20% behind it (ink at 6% on light grounds).

items.title: Navbar at 1920
items.text: The content stops at the column (1520) widened by the 8px of air in the logo's and icons' boxes: the logo glyph and the last icon stand on the column's edges (200 and 1720).

items.title: Navbar at 900: short sections
items.text: From 48em to 64em: «Каталог, Бизнесу, Журнал, Контакты» (before: the burger from 64em down).

items.title: Navbar at 700: the burger
items.text: From 40em to 48em the sections go behind the burger; the tools stay.

items.title: Phone 390 × 844: tab bar and hero
items.text: Under 40em the bag, favourites and profile leave the bar for the tab bar (Каталог, Корзина, Избранное, Профиль). The hero: screen less 24 less the tab bar (764), the title in three lines, the countdown as wide as its caption.

items.title: Navbar over business
items.text: Before: white everywhere but the hero. After: cool grey over the business block — it changes once the bar stands wholly on a section, crossing over in 0.6s.

items.title: Navbar over the dark image block
items.text: Black over «Наш подход», with the white 30% hairline under it.

items.title: Hero at 1440 × 900
items.text: Height 876 (the screen less 24; before 800). Three rows shared by the countdown and the links (104px each, centres within 0px); the eased fade; the title word under word.

items.title: Hero at 1920 × 1080
items.text: The column at its most (1520): the cells are framed by a hairline on each side and the title stands 48px off the left one.

items.title: Hero at 1024 × 768
items.text: 744 tall (before 648); digits 247 = caption 247 wide (before the caption wrapped to two lines).

items.title: Hero on a Friday afternoon
items.text: More than a day to the next roast: «ПН, 26 ОКТ» in place of the digits (mono: Technology has no Cyrillic), as wide as the caption.

items.title: Hero link hover
items.text: The link's cell gets the white tint; its arrow still nudges 6px.

items.title: Lines on white
items.text: The pack square's divider was ink 10%, the arrows' #d5d5d6: now every line is ink 20% on light grounds.

items.title: Product on a phone
items.text: The buy bar stands on the tab bar; the pinned stage is 56px shorter for it.

items.title: A pack pressed
items.text: Held down: the pack goes 0.45 back (from its hover lift of +0.35 to −0.10) and to 94% of its size, its shadow closer; it stays while held and returns on release (a click holds it at least 0.2s).

items.ask: On reload the scroll position should stay the same
items.done: The site keeps the place itself (scripts/scroll.js): saved per address in the tab, put back instantly after a reload or a step back, and again while fonts, pictures and the packs settle, until you scroll. Measured after a reload: home 3000 → 3000, catalog 2500 → 2500, a coffee 2600 → 2600 (1440 × 900), home 2200 → 2200 (390 × 844). Headless Chromium restored these before too, so the failure you saw is browser-specific: please check where you saw it.

items.ask: On scroll should lag a bit behind
items.done: Every pack trails its slot by up to 12% of its height (at most 40px) and catches up at 9 per second: after a quick scroll of 700px on the catalog it trails 38px and is back within 0.5s (38 → 26 → 12 → 5 → 2 px every 60ms). Sideways rows too. Nothing with «reduce motion». TUNE.lag, lagMax in the console.

items.ask: On click moving away a bit (on hold stays moved away)
items.done: Pointer down on a pack: 0.45 further from the viewer and 94% of its size (from the hover state +0.35 / 103% to −0.10 / 96.8%), the shadow closer; it stays while held and comes back on release; a quick click holds it for at least 0.2s so it reads. On touch it waits 90ms (a touch may be the start of a scroll).

items.ask: 1. Remove separating lines between the elements
items.done: The hairlines between the three groups are gone; the groups are 16px apart (the links 8px of padding each side).

items.ask: 2. Hovers for links and icons semi-transparent white, not affecting other elements
items.done: Only the hovered item changes: a tint behind its 40px cell (logo, links, icons). White at 20% on dark grounds; on white and cloud, where white cannot show, ink at 6% — the same step in the light ground's ink (decision hover-tint). Before: the other links dimmed to 60%.

items.ask: 3. Left and right padding set to small
items.done: The bar's own margin is 16px at every width (the gutter of a 320 screen), the glyphs 16px from the screen's edges (before 12 → 44 with the gutter).

items.ask: 4. [additional padding]
items.done: Read together with 5: the 8px of air inside the logo's and the icons' boxes is counted in the max width. Tell me if you meant something else.

items.ask: 5. Max width, systematic, counting the logo's and icons' padding
items.done: The content stops at --col-max + 2 × 8px (1536): from a 1616 screen on, the logo glyph and the last icon glyph stand exactly on the column's edges (measured: 0px off at 1680, 1920 and 2560; before 36, 156 and 476px outside).

items.ask: 6. Add profile icon
items.done: A profile icon in the set's 1.5px line, after the bag (and in the tab bar). It leads nowhere yet: there is no profile page.

items.ask: 7. Max width for the inner container, systematic with other max widths
items.done: The same width as 5: .nav__in is the content column (1520) plus the 8px of air on each side. One max width for everything on the page.

items.ask: 8. Colour by the section behind, smoothly, once fully on it
items.done: Every section says its ground (data-ground: white, cloud, black, cool grey) and the bar takes its colours once its whole 48px stand on that section; while a boundary crosses the bar it keeps its colours. They cross over in 0.6s (--t-move). Measured on the home page: black over the hero, white over the coffees, black over «Наш подход», white over «О компании», cool grey over business, white over the facts. The tab bar follows the section at the screen's foot the same way.

items.ask: 9. Smaller sizes: short links, then the burger, then a bottom menu
items.done: Four steps: every section from 64em (1024), «Каталог, Бизнесу, Журнал, Контакты» from 48em (768), the burger below, and under 40em (640) the favourites, bag and profile leave for a tab bar at the foot with «Каталог, Корзина, Избранное, Профиль». The widths are the screens of the column steps L and M, where each row fits with room to spare (the sections 584px + two outer columns of 172px at 1024; the short ones 288 + 2 × 172 at 768). The audit now fails if the sections touch the logo or the tools.

items.ask: 10. Links to pages, not anchors; no page, no link
items.done: Only «Кофе» and «Каталог» link (to the catalog). Каскара, Дрипы, Сеты, Кофейням, Офисам, Бизнесу, Журнал, Контакты, search, favourites, bag and profile are labels without a link (<a> without href) until their page exists; each becomes a link by adding its path in data/site.json (decision nav-links-pages). The hero's and the footer's links are unchanged: should the same rule apply there?

items.ask: 11. Scrolling above the page turns it white
items.done: Above the top (a touchpad or phone bounce) the bars keep the first section's ground (black on the home page), and the page behind the bounce is that colour too: the top half of the page bounces in its first ground, the bottom half in its last (the footer's cloud). A real bounce cannot be made in a headless browser: please check on your Mac and phone.

items.ask: 12. A counter only on the bag
items.done: The favourites count is gone (navbar and tab bar); the bag keeps its lavender count.

items.ask: 1. Height: full minus 24px; a system of min and max
items.done: The screen less 24 (less the 56px tab bar on a phone), at most --hero-max (960 → 1200: a portrait tablet, a 2560 screen), and never less than the cells, the fade (--hero-fade 64 → 160) and a strip of photo (--hero-photo 48 → 120) need. Measured: 876 at 1440 × 900 (was 800), 1056 at 1920 × 1080, 744 at 1024 × 768, 764 at 390 × 844; 1067 at 820 × 1180 and 1200 at 2560 × 1440 (the max). Short phones get the content's height: 638 at 320 × 568.

items.ask: 2. Ease the black gradient
items.done: An eased fade in 16 stops along an S-curve (cubic-bezier 0.42, 0, 0.58, 1), as tw-easing-gradients, generated into --fade-black from colors.json; 160px tall at 1440 (was 48px, two stops). The featured photo caption and the business cards use the same fade.

items.ask: 3. All texts in the three blocks trimmed
items.done: text-box: trim-both cap alphabetic on the title, the day row, the digits, the caption and the links: each row's padding is the space you see (12 → 20px). Chrome and Safari 18.2+; Firefox keeps the line's air.

items.ask: 4. Title always three lines
items.done: Word under word, at every width: 3 lines at all 25 screens measured (before 1 or 2 lines below 1024).

items.ask: 5. The middle block in three containers, aligned with the three links
items.done: From M the countdown and the links share three equal rows (CSS subgrid): the day and the time beside «Каталог», the digits beside «Бизнесу», the caption beside «Контакты». Centres within 0px at every screen measured (before 3–13px off). Rows are as tall as the digits need: 104px at 1440.

items.ask: 6. Left and right border on the inner container from a max width
items.done: A new container step max (1520px: the column at its most). From there the cells are framed by a hairline on each side and the title stands 48px off the left one. 1440 has none; 1680, 1920 and 2560 have them.

items.ask: 7. Hover on the links
items.done: The link's whole cell gets the hover tint (white 20%), and the arrow keeps its 6px nudge.

items.ask: 8. Elements as wide as «ДО БЛИЖАЙШЕЙ ОБЖАРКИ»
items.done: The caption is 13.9em of the control size; the day row is that wide, the digits are sized to it (control × 13.9 / 3), and the countdown font is now tabular (every digit as wide as «0»), so it is exactly as wide every second: 275 = 275 at 1440, 200 = 200 at 390. The audit checks it at every size (decision countdown-as-caption).

items.ask: 9. More than 24h to wait: the date and «До ближайшей обжарки»
items.done: From Friday 10:00 to Sunday 10:00 (with the placeholder weekday schedule) the digits give way to the date of the next roast, «ПН, 26 ОКТ», in the mono of the headings (Technology has no Cyrillic), sized by its letters to the caption's width; screen readers hear «Следующая обжарка в понедельник, 26 октября».

items.ask: 10. On load the bar rises in from opacity 0 and from below
items.done: The cells rise one section gap (24 → 48px) and fade in over 0.9s on --ease-out, 0.2s after the page opens (--t-rise, new). Not with «reduce motion».

items.ask: Always cool gray 20% on light and white 30% on dark
items.done: One --line, set by each section's ground: ink 20% on white and cloud, white 30% on black and cool grey. Changed: the navbar's line (ink 10% → 20%), the hero's (white 40% → 30%), the featured pack square and the product lots (ink 10%), arrows, fields and the catalog panel (#d5d5d6 or ink). A new rule in build/rules.mjs fails any border that is not var(--line); only states (the current pager dot, a focused field) may draw in ink, and drawn marks (the weight dot, a chevron) in currentColor.

blocks.title: What this changes that you may not expect
items: The hero is taller than the screen on small and sideways phones: 638 at 320 × 568 (it was 555), 549 at 844 × 390 (was 376) — three title lines and a countdown as wide as its caption take more room. From 390 × 844 up it is the screen less 24.
Most navbar items lead nowhere now (no page behind them): only «Кофе» / «Каталог» are links. On a phone, «Корзина», «Избранное», «Профиль» in the tab bar do nothing yet.
At 1024–1600 the navbar's logo no longer lines up with the content column (it stands at 16px; the column at the gutter, up to 48px): that is the «small» padding. From 1616 on they line up.
The navbar on light grounds hovers in ink, not white (white would be invisible on white).
On a phone the page ends 56px lower (the tab bar's room under the footer), and the product's pinned stage is 56px shorter.
The countdown is a little smaller than before at 1440 (93 instead of 96px): its size now follows the caption.

sections.title: The system
sections.sub: design/scale.json: one range (320 → 1440), one ladder, roles with two ends. build/tokens.mjs writes one clamp() per role and checks the rules.

blocks.title: The ladder
blocks.sub: Steps of 2 up to 24, of 4 up to 64, of 8 up to 128, of 16 up to 256. Every end of every role sits on it (dots).

blocks.title: Text roles
blocks.sub: Value at 320 and 1440 (constant outside), the face, where it is used, and the Figma steps at 320 / 768 / 1280 / 1440 / 1920 where one exists.
rows: section headings, the catalog tabs, the product's name on its page
headings of the image blocks (approach, about)
the name of the featured coffee
names on product cards, titles of tiles (business, info blocks, product facts), footer headings
eyebrows above headings («Наш подход»): set apart by colour and case, not size
the big sentence of a product's story
the caption over the featured photo, the text under a section heading
longer text: the featured description, the story columns, business text
card descriptions, lists, links of the navbar and the footer, fields
descriptor pills, captions above values in the buy bar, the copyright
big actions and values set in bold capitals: hero links, «В корзину», buy-bar values
prices and weights on cards (medium capitals)

blocks.title: Levels that must stay apart
blocks.sub: The ratio of each pair at 320 (light) and at 1440 (dark). Two straight lines keep their ratio between its two end values, so the ends prove every size.

blocks.title: The height counts
blocks.sub: --vp = min(100vw, 2 × 100svh − 25rem): the width a screen counts as. 360 tall → the 320 sizes; 920 tall → the 1440 sizes.
blocks.note: The size a screen gets is the smaller of its width and this line.

blocks.title: Space and size roles
rows: side margin of every section: the content column starts here
space above and below a section's content
the tighter edge of a section that follows a related one (new arrivals → recommended)
from a section heading to its content
between rows of product cards (each card carries a description below it)
padding of big blocks: the featured text card, the text of image blocks, info blocks
padding of tiles: product facts, business descriptions, filter cells
height of the card's buy row and of big buttons
side padding of buttons and controls
padding above and below each row of the hero's cells (three rows: the roast's parts beside the three links)
the least photo the hero shows between the navbar and the fade into its cells
the eased fade from the hero's photo into the black of its cells
the most the hero may be tall: below it, the screen less a 24px peek (a tall portrait or 2560 screen stops here)
least height of the image blocks (approach, about)
width of the flame mark in the footer
the 3D pack on a product page: the side of its square (also capped by the screen's height)

blocks.title: Colours
blocks.sub: design/colors.json; text pairs checked for contrast on every build.

sections.title: The navbar and the tab bar
sections.sub: New this round: four steps, the colours of the section under it, one max width with the column, a tab bar on phones.

items.title: Steps
items.html: Every section in three groups from 64em (1024, the screen of L); «Каталог, Бизнесу, Журнал, Контакты» from 48em (768, the screen of M); the burger below; under 40em (640) the tab bar. In em, so bigger browser text takes the narrower step sooner. media.css: --links-full, --links, --phone.

items.title: Width
items.html: The bar's margin is 16px (the small gutter); its content min(100% − 2 × (16 − 8), --col-max + 2 × 8): the logo's and icons' boxes carry 8px of air, so the glyphs stand 16px from the edges, and on the column's edges once it is at its most (1616 and up).

items.title: Grounds
items.html: Sections say data-ground (paper, cloud, black, ink); it sets --g-bg, --g-fg, --line and --tint. The bar takes a ground once its whole height is over that section, crossing over in 0.6s; at the top of the page (and above it) the first section's. The tab bar does the same at the foot of the screen.

items.title: Hover
items.html: A tint behind the one item: --tint, white 20% on dark grounds, ink 6% on light ones. 0.2s in, 0.45s out. Nothing else on the bar changes.

items.title: Links
items.html: An item links only to a page that exists (data/site.json nav: a second value is the path). Today: «Кофе» and «Каталог». The rest are <a> without href: shown, not clickable, not in the tab order.

items.title: Tab bar
items.html: 56px + the safe area, four equal cells with icon and label (--type-small); the bag's count only. Everything fixed to the foot stands on it through --tabbar-h (the buy bar, the toast, the menu's height, the hero).

blocks.title: The navbar at 25 screens
blocks.sub: Step: what the bar shows. Icons: the tools in the bar. Logo / icon: how far the logo glyph and the last icon glyph stand inside the content column's edges (negative: outside it, in the gutter).

sections.title: The hero
sections.sub: The first screen of the home page: the photo, the eased fade, the title, the countdown to the next roast, three links.

items.title: Height
items.html: min(100svh − 24 − tab bar, --hero-max), and never less than the navbar + --hero-photo (48 → 120) + --hero-fade (64 → 160) + the cells. --hero-max 960 → 1200 stops a portrait tablet or a 2560 screen (decision hero-height).

items.title: Rows
items.html: Below M the title, the countdown and the links stack. From M the countdown and the links share three equal rows (subgrid), title above; from L the title takes the first cell beside them. Row padding --hero-cell-y 12 → 20; texts trimmed to cap height and baseline.

items.title: Countdown
items.html: Everything as wide as the caption (13.9em of --type-control): the digits are control × 13.9 / 3 in tabular Technology (build/fonts.py), a date control × 13.9 / (0.65 × its letters) in mono. More than 24h to wait shows the date. Moscow time, the placeholder weekday schedule.

items.title: Frame
items.html: At the container step max (the column at 1520px) the cells get a hairline on each side and the title 48px of padding.

items.title: Fade
items.html: --fade-black: 16 stops along cubic-bezier(0.42, 0, 0.58, 1), from colors.json fades; over --hero-fade.

items.title: Entrance
items.html: The cells rise one section gap and fade in, 0.9s on --ease-out after 0.2s (--t-rise).

blocks.title: The hero at 25 screens
blocks.sub: Before (struck) and now. Peek: what shows of the next block under the hero, above the tab bar (negative: taller than the screen). Lines: the title. Digits / caption: their drawn widths. Align: the largest distance between a link's centre and its countdown part's (from M).

sections.title: The product stage and the buy bar
sections.sub: A coffee's page: the pack pinned while the fact tiles scroll past, the buy bar at the foot.

items.title: Pin
items.html: Height 100svh − navbar − buy bar (at least 22rem), pinned for as long as the five tiles take to pass; the tiles are 40% of the screen's height apart (28% from L), so scroll time is measured in screens (decision product-pin).

items.title: Pack
items.html: --stage 320 → 720, capped by the pin. It turns once around with qqStage.progress; tiles are frosted (cloud 70% + blur 40px) so the pack shows through them.

items.title: Buy bar
items.html: Two rows of cells below L (options; quantity, price, «В корзину»), one row from L as in Figma. New this round: on a screen under 32em tall it waits after the stage instead of following the screen, which pins at the whole screen under the navbar (decision short-screens).

blocks.title: The product stage at 25 screens
blocks.sub: Pin: the pinned height. Pack: the 3D box. Under bar: how much of the pack box the buy bar covers. Bar: its height and rows ("after": past the stage on a short screen).

sections.title: The catalog
sections.sub: Tabs, filters kept in the address, the grid.

items.title: Filters
items.html: Seven cells (sort, price of 200 g, type, line, country, processing, preparation) that wrap by width: 7 rows at 320, 4 at 375, 2 from 730, one row from 1260. A panel that would stick out on the right opens leftwards. The choice lives in the address, so a filtered catalog can be shared.

items.title: Grid
items.html: One column below M, two at M, and from L six tracks: the first four cards take half a row, the rest a third — the rhythm of the Figma catalog, kept only in the default order.

items.title: Tabs
items.html: «Все» and «Кофе» show the coffee; каскара, дрипы, сеты and мерч say they are coming (not in the shop yet).

blocks.title: The catalog at 25 screens
blocks.sub: First row: cards in the first row (the first four take half a row from M). Filters: rows of filter cells. First card: its top on the screen.

sections.title: The whole responsive picture
sections.sub: Every role and block size as the browser resolves it, every 10px of width (a screen 1100 tall) and every 25px of height (1440 wide). Dashed grey: round 1. Moved this round: --hero-cell-y (20 → 40 became 12 → 20), the hero's height, rows, photo strip and digits (Hero tab), the navbar's step and content width (Navbar tab), the pinned stage under 640 (the tab bar); new: --hero-photo, --hero-fade, --hero-max (no line before).

labels.navStep: navbar step (1 tab bar, 2 burger, 3 short, 4 every section)
labels.navLogoX: logo glyph from the screen edge

sections.title: Responsive map
sections.sub: What each block does at each width, from the sweep. Accent lines: the shared column steps (S, M, L land at these screen widths because the column is the screen less two gutters). Dashed: the navbar's page step.

items: Round 2 moved the navbar's steps (before: the burger under 64em) and added two: 48em and 40em. The page steps now sit at the screens of the column steps (768 ≈ M, 1024 ≈ L), so with a 16px text the navbar changes together with the blocks. The new container step max (the column at 1520px, from about 1616) frames the hero. No block step moved.
S (22rem column) lands at about 380: it changes small things inside cards (the filter cells, the buy-bar captions), so it shows no row here.
Every block changes at the same two widths, about 750 and 1000; only the navbar has its own step (64em, so bigger browser text gets the burger sooner).
The catalog filter cells wrap by their own width (they flow), so their rows change at 370, 550, 730 and 1260 with no step.

sections.title: Motion
sections.sub: src/styles/base/motion.css: three curves and four times (--t-rise is new). With «reduce motion» every time is 0 and the packs stand still, without lag or press.

items.name: out
items.use: arriving and settling: hovers, panels, the toast coming in

items.name: pack follow
items.use: the packs follow their targets (scroll lean, pointer turn) at 9 per second

items.name: pack lag (new)
items.use: how a pack catches up with its slot after a scroll: 1 − e^(−9t), soft-capped at 12% of its height (≤ 40px)

rows.name: product pack turn (one turn over 5 tiles)
rows.label: as long as the scroll through the stage

rows.name: navbar / tab bar cross to a new ground (--t-move)
pack catches up after a scroll (to 95%)
pack press in / out (16 per second, to 95%)

items.title: In fast, out slow
items.html: Hovers come in at 0.2s and leave at 0.45s, so a pointer passing over a list leaves a soft trail (as Flow Medium).

items.title: One loop
items.html: The hero photo drifts 8% over 40s and back; it is the only thing that moves by itself, and it stops with «reduce motion».

items.title: Weight (new)
items.html: The packs trail the page a little and catch up as it stops, so they feel set on the shelf rather than printed on it; pressed, they give way.

items.title: Colour crossings (new)
items.html: The bars change colour only when wholly over a section, on the travel curve and time, so a boundary never flickers through them.

sections.title: The grammar
sections.sub: How the site is drawn, in plain words, and which of these rules a script checks.

items.title: Colour
items.html: Ink #2d2f33 on paper, cloud #f6f6f6 for surfaces (cards, tiles, the buy bar), graphite and black for dark blocks, lavender for eyebrows and info icons. Secondary text is ink at 70%; 60% only for large text. Every section names its ground; lines and hover tints follow it: ink 20% / white 30%, ink 6% / white 20%.

items.title: Type
items.html: Mono bold capitals tracked 0.05em for names and headings; Apercu for everything read; Technology digits for the countdown. Labels (eyebrows, controls, prices) differ by case and colour, not size.

items.title: Size
items.html: Every size a line from 320 to 1440 on one ladder; the screen's height counts; nothing grows past 1440, the column stops at 1520.

items.title: Shape
items.html: Sharp rectangles divided by hairlines; only pills and dots are round.

items.title: Layout
items.html: Everything sits in the content column; full-bleed blocks put their content in a column too, so they change at the same steps S, M, L.

items.title: Motion
items.html: Three curves, three times, one loop; the packs follow scroll and pointer.

blocks.title: Rules
rows: Sizes only from the scale; screen units only where a decision says
Layout steps only at S, M, L, max (and 64em, 48em, 40em, 32em tall)
No rounded corners except pills and dots
Type levels ≥ ×1.125 apart at both ends
One line colour: borders only var(--line) (new)
The navbar's sections never touch the logo or the tools (new, audit)
The countdown as wide as its caption (new, audit)
Links only to pages that exist (new)
Fixed bars stand on the tab bar (--tabbar-h) (new)
A hover changes only its own item (new)
Every row that scrolls sideways is position: relative
3D canvas at z-index 5; what shows above packs ≥ 6
Links inside the site through href(ctx, to)
One heading level per section; names in mono, text in Apercu
Cells inside a block share hairlines (margin −1px), never double lines

sections.title: Checks
sections.sub: What was checked, how, and what is kept on purpose.

items.text: clean — 4 pages × 12 sizes
all hold (build/rules.mjs); «one line colour» new
sideways scroll at every 10px from 320 to 1920
14 decisions, 3 exceptions, 9 placeholders

blocks.title: The rules (run on every build and in CI)

items.title: Colours only from tokens
items.how: no #hex, colour functions or named colours in 13 stylesheets

items.title: Sizes only from the scale
items.how: font sizes are --type-* (or the 16px floor of fields, 12px of the counter); screen units only in 4 rules listed in decisions.json

items.title: Layout steps only at S, M, L
items.how: container queries at 22rem, 43rem, 58rem, 1520px on the column; media only through media.css (--links-full 64em, --links 48em, --phone 40em, --short 32em tall, input, motion)

items.title: Motion only from motion.css
items.how: transitions use var(--t-in/out/move) and var(--ease-out/move/leave); the hero's slow drift is the one loop

items.title: Faces only through tokens
items.how: font-family is var(--sans), var(--mono) or var(--digits)

items.title: The scale holds its own rules
items.how: both ends of 33 roles on the ladder, 9 type pairs ≥ ×1.125, 14 colour pairs

items.title: One line colour
items.how: every border is var(--line), set by the ground to ink-20 or white-30 (4 places); states may use ink

items.what: Headings and names are set in JetBrains Mono Bold (Google Fonts, self-hosted), not PT Mono Bold as in Figma
items.why: Google Fonts has PT Mono only in Regular; JetBrains Mono Bold was the closest of eleven Google monospace faces with Cyrillic in weight and shape (compared side by side)

items.what: The countdown digits are Technology Bold, subset to 0–9 and the colon (1.2 KB)
items.why: the font of the Figma hero; the file came from Tim

items.what: Every 3D pack shows the label of Индонезия Суматра Паллунг
items.why: only that label exists as art; products.json gives every coffee art: sumatra-front/back

items.what: Prices are placeholders by price group and weight (data/prices.json: Classic 250 / 680 / 2600 ₽ for 50 г / 200 г / 1 кг, Citric 290 / 780 / 2900, Special 390 / 1180 / 4400)
items.why: the price table has no prices

items.what: The photos are the Figma moodboard's: several show other roasters' packs (SIP, Cafe Public, Paloma, Stereoscope, MARU) and none is QQ's own; they are renders exported from Figma at 1280–1440 px
items.why: no other pictures yet

items.what: The hero shows a still of the Figma video (13456698-hd_1920_1080_30fps), drifting slowly, 1280 px wide
items.why: the video file is not in the Figma file's exports

items.what: The countdown and the catalog's shipping line assume roasting on weekdays at 10:00 Moscow time
items.why: Figma shows a countdown but no schedule

items.what: The sentences behind the plus of the three info blocks (roasting, payment, delivery) were written for the site
items.why: Figma has the plus but not the text

items.what: «В корзину» and the heart keep the bag and the favourites in the visitor's browser only (localStorage); there is no bag page, checkout, search, account or newsletter behind the site
items.why: these pages are not designed yet

items.what: Under 48em the sections open from the burger as a plain list
items.why: the menu is not designed

items.what: «Популярные» (the catalog's default order): coffees with a tag first, then Special, then the newest
items.why: no sales data

items.what: «Кофе с похожим вкусом»: the four coffees nearest in density, acidity, sweetness and ferment, nearer for each shared flavour family of descriptors and for the same line
items.why: the table has no explicit links between coffees

items.what: Secondary text is ink-70 (#2d2f33 at 70%), never ink-60 or ink-50 as some Figma texts are (the unchosen weight «1 кг», small numbers of the pager)
items.why: ink-60 is 3.8 : 1 on white and ink-50 2.9 : 1, below 4.5 : 1 for text; ink-60 stays only for large text (the inactive catalog tabs, 3 : 1) and parts of controls

items.what: No rounded corners: blocks, cards, buttons and fields are sharp; only pills (descriptors, the bag counter) and dots are round
items.why: the brand's grid of hairlines; Figma has no radius except pills

items.what: The navbar is 48px at every size, its links in --type-body; its own side margin is 16px (the small gutter) and its content stops at the column widened by the 8px of air inside the logo's and icons' boxes
items.why: a control, not a block: as in every Figma frame; Tim, round 2: the side padding «small», a systematic max width counting the air around the logo and the icons

items.what: The hero is the screen less a 24px peek (less the tab bar on a phone), at most --hero-max (960 → 1200); never less than its cells, the fade and --hero-photo need
items.why: a screen-sized block (the rule of the system: such blocks are measured by the screen's height directly); Tim, round 2: «full minus 24px» with a min and a max by screen size

items.what: The product stage is pinned at the height of the screen less the navbar and the buy bar; the fact tiles are spaced by 40% of the screen's height (28% from L)
items.why: the pack turns as the tiles pass: the distance between them is scroll time, which is measured in screens

items.what: Everything in the roast cell is as wide as its caption «До ближайшей обжарки» (13.9em of --type-control): the digits are --type-control × 13.9 / 3, the date (more than a day to wait) × 13.9 / (0.65 × its letters) in mono
items.why: Tim, round 2: «the elements should be the max width of the caption»; Technology has no Cyrillic, so the date «Пт, 9 Окт» is set in the mono of the headings

items.what: Four coffees show a photo on their card instead of the 3D pack (data/site.json photos), as the Figma catalog mixes them
items.why: the rhythm of the Figma catalog

items.what: On a narrow column the buy bar stays at the foot of the screen in two rows (options; quantity, price, button)
items.why: Figma has the bar only at 1440; buying should stay one tap away

items.what: On a screen under 32em tall (a phone sideways) the buy bar waits after the product stage instead of following the screen, and the stage pins at the whole screen under the navbar (no 22rem floor)
items.why: measured at 844 × 390: the two-row bar took 129 of 390px and covered the pack by 139px; a pinned block must fit the screen or not pin

items.what: The navbar in four steps: every section (≥ 64em), four short ones «Каталог, Бизнесу, Журнал, Контакты» (≥ 48em), the burger, and under 40em a tab bar at the foot of the screen with «Каталог, Корзина, Избранное, Профиль»
items.why: Tim, round 2; the widths are the screens of the column steps L and M (1024, 768), where each row fits with room to spare (measured)

items.what: Navbar and tab-bar items link only to pages that exist (the catalog): «Каскара», «Дрипы», «Сеты», «Кофейням», «Офисам», «Бизнесу», «Журнал», «Контакты», search, favourites, bag and profile are labels without a link
items.why: Tim, round 2: «links to pages, not anchors; if there's no page, don't add any link»

items.what: The navbar (and the tab bar) take the colours of the section under them, changing once wholly over it, on --t-move; above the top of the page they keep the first section's
items.why: Tim, round 2

items.what: Hover on the navbar, the tab bar and the hero's links: a tint behind the one item, white at 20% on dark grounds, ink at 6% on light ones (white would not show on white)
items.why: Tim, round 2: «semi-transparent white, not affecting other elements»

items.what: Every hairline is var(--line): cool grey at 20% on light grounds, white at 30% on dark ones; only states (the current dot of the pager, a focused field) draw a border in ink
items.why: Tim, round 2: «borders always cool gray 20% on light and white 30% on dark»

blocks.title: The independent review
blocks.sub: A separate agent that had not seen the round checked the built site against your comments, the rules and the three pages in a browser. Its findings and what was done about each:
items: high The product page scrolled sideways at 280–340 (pack still 320 wide in a 288 pin; 56px over at 280). — the pin's column is minmax(0, 1fr) and the pack max-width 100%: no overflow at 270–340 on both coffees; the audit now includes 280 × 653.
high The focus ring of «В корзину» was white on the light buy bar (drawn in the text colour). — filled buttons draw their ring in ink (paper on dark grounds): measured rgb(45, 47, 51).

high The 3D canvas could paint over card names, hearts and buy rows (the card's isolation boxed their z-index under the canvas). — no isolation; photo at 0, canvas 5, link 6, name, heart and buy row 7 in the page's stacking; the empty part of the name row lets clicks through.
high An open filter panel covered the focused card after tabbing out (WCAG 2.4.11). — a cell closes when the focus leaves it: after six Tabs from «Приготовление» the panel is closed.
medium Back did nothing for filters (replaceState only). — each change is a history step, typing a price one step; popstate re-reads the address: Кения, Перу, Back → Кения, 2 coffees.
medium URLSearchParams.size is Safari 17+. — the address is written with toString().
medium iPhone zoomed into the buy-bar selects (14.4px). — max(16px, --type-control): 16px at 390.
medium Focus fell to the page when «Меньше» or a slider arrow disabled itself. — aria-disabled instead of disabled; focus stays on «Меньше» at quantity 1.
medium The home page was too wide under 320 (pager and arrows). — the section head's controls wrap: no overflow at 270–340.
medium Build targets (Safari 15, Firefox 100) were below what the CSS needs. — targets raised to Chrome/Edge 111, Safari/iOS 16.4, Firefox 121 (container queries and :has()); README lists them.

low The rules lint had loopholes (oklch, named colours, radius longhands, font shorthand, dvw/svw, delays, unnamed or compound container queries, matchMedia quotes, media.css). — all closed and proven with a planted file (6 of 9 rules failed on it). Not closed: hard-coded spacing lengths in components (about 250) — see Next. partly

low Q-Optimistic and Q-Punch list countries that contradict their lots (Уганда in the lots). — from the table itself (the sticker column vs the green-coffee column): left as the table says, a question for you in Next. open
low Колумбия Декаф missing under «Фильтр». — the preparation filter also reads the Применение column: it is there now.
low «Скоро здесь появятся каскара»; a wrong comment; ?max=0. — «появится каскара / появятся дрипы»; comment fixed; max=0 now means «up to 0» as its cell says.
low The screen-reader «Показать» button took a tab stop. — tabindex −1 (it stays for the form's validity and Enter).
low After a sort one card was left alone in the last row. — the number of half-width cards is chosen so the thirds fill their rows: 2, 2 then rows of 3 for «cheap».

Checked and fine by the review: every 10px 280–1920, heights 360–1100, filter panels on screen, the product stage at five sizes, keyboard reach, filter results against the data, all 25 coffees against an independent CSV parse, reduced motion, 3D clipping, no WebGL, CSP and HTML validity.

sections.title: Next
sections.sub: What is open, what I need from you, and what to check on real devices.

blocks.title: Questions from this round
items: Navbar 4, «[additional padding]»: I read it with 5 (the air inside the logo's and icons' boxes). Did you mean something else?
Hover on light grounds: white is invisible on white, so the tint there is ink at 6%. Keep, or another tint?
Links without pages: the hero's «Бизнесу», «Контакты» and the footer's links still go to anchors or «#». Should the same rule (no page, no link) apply there?
Short phones: the hero is taller than the screen at 320 × 568 and sideways (three title lines and the wide countdown). Is that fine, or should short screens get a tighter hero?
The reload keeps its place in Chromium (it did before as well): in which browser did you see it jump?

blocks.title: Still needed from you (from round 1)

Real prices into data/prices.json.
Each coffee's label at 512 and 1024 px, front and back.
QQ's own photos (the current ones are Figma's moodboard).
The roast schedule and the hero video.
The texts behind the plus of the info blocks.
PT Mono Bold with a web licence.
Countries of the blends: the sticker column or the lots?

Pages for the navbar's items: каскара, дрипы, сеты, бизнесу (кофейням, офисам), журнал, контакты, search, favourites, bag, profile.
Checkout, account; merch; the journal.

From round 1: on a coffee's page at 1440 × 900 the big pack is cut at the top of its box while it settles; card descriptions cannot be drag-selected in Chromium.

blocks.title: Check on real devices
items: Safari (Mac and iPhone): the bounce above the page stays black on the home page; text-box trim in the hero; the scroll place after a reload.
iPhone: the tab bar with the home indicator (safe area), the buy bar standing on it, the URL bar moving.
A trackpad and a mouse wheel: is the packs' lag «a bit», or too much / too little? (TUNE.lag and lagMax in the console.)
Pressing a pack on a card: the press shows, then the coffee's page opens.

items.ask: Build the QQ Coffee website from the Figma file, hosted on GitHub
items.done: Static Vite site in timofeylebedev/qq, branch site-system; every push to main publishes to timofeylebedev.github.io/qq (deploy.yml; Pages source must be set to GitHub Actions once).

items.ask: Start with the main, catalog and product pages; other pages only as context
items.done: Home, catalog and one page per coffee (25), from one set of components. Not built: bag, checkout, search, favourites, account, other categories, journal, business pages (see Next).

items.ask: Figma is general inspiration, not exact values or structure
items.done: Sizes come from the site's own scale; structure follows Figma (sections, cells, hairlines, mono capitals). Where Figma differs between frames, the site takes one line through them: e.g. h2 32→48 where Figma has 32 / 36 / 40 / 48 steps.

items.ask: A fluid system, not breakpoints (exceptions allowed)
items.done: Every size is a straight line from its value at 320 to its value at 1440 (31 roles in design/scale.json), constant outside; the screen's height counts (a screen 360 tall gets the 320 sizes, 920 tall the 1440 sizes). Layout changes at only three shared column steps S 22rem, M 43rem, L 58rem, plus the navbar at 64em. Four exceptions use screen units on purpose, listed in decisions.json.

items.ask: A system within pages and between screen sizes
items.done: One ladder (steps 2/4/8/16), type levels ≥ ×1.125 apart at both ends, colours only from design/colors.json with contrast checks, one motion vocabulary; build/rules.mjs checks 9 rules on every build and in CI.

items.ask: Flow Medium's size system as inspiration
items.done: Taken from it: roles with two ends, the height-capped viewport (--vp), the ladder, relations, a decisions register, the rules check, the audit at 11 sizes, this report. Not taken: its modular ratio (QQ's Figma uses round values).

items.ask: Use the CSV, only rows «На сайте» = «Да»
items.done: 25 coffees from data/products.csv (Колумбия Вуш-Вуш appeared twice: the fuller row wins). Taste scores, descriptors, processing, lots, countries, tags and roast use reach the cards, filters and product tiles.

items.ask: Prices
items.done: Placeholder prices per price group and weight in data/prices.json, marked as such (decision price-placeholder).

items.ask: Labels on the packs
items.done: The Sumatra label on every pack, as you chose (decision pack-label).

items.ask: Fonts: Apercu (attached), Google fonts, Technology
items.done: Apercu Pro 400/500/700 self-hosted and subset; headings in JetBrains Mono Bold (Google has PT Mono only in Regular — decision font-headings); countdown digits in Technology Bold (your file, 1.2 KB subset).

items.ask: The pack moves in 3D on scroll
items.done: The pack is pinned under the navbar while five fact tiles scroll past and turns once around with them; it settles in from a quarter turn on load; still with «reduce motion».

items.ask: Packs on grey use the existing 3D model
items.done: One WebGL canvas per page draws every card's pack (your renderer as an ES module); cards lean with the scroll and turn to the pointer. A still of the same pack shows before WebGL draws and without it.

items.ask: Animated footer logo
items.done: Waiting for the file or link; the footer shows the static logo meanwhile.

items.ask: Use analyzing-design-systems, full-system-report, responsive-web-design, be-more-ambitious
items.done: Figma frames measured into the size roles; this page is the full system report; the audit runs 4 pages × 12 sizes with axe and a 24px-text pass; an independent agent reviewed the work and its 16 findings were fixed or answered (Checks).

items.ask: Ask questions; report missing things later
items.done: Asked about repo, logo, labels, prices and fonts. Missing things are in Next.

blocks.title: Where the site departs from Figma, or does something you may not expect
items: Headings are JetBrains Mono, not PT Mono: narrower, with a different «Ж» and «Ш». A licence for PT Mono Bold swaps it in one line.
Sizes in between Figma frames are not Figma's: the site draws one line through each role, so e.g. the hero title is 55 at 1024 where Figma would show 56 (768 frame) or 64 (990 frame).
The countdown is 96 at 1440 and above, where Figma's 1920 frame has 128: nothing grows past 1440.
Figma's featured slide has a photo; the site shows the 3D pack unless data/site.json names a photo for that coffee.
On a phone sideways the hero is taller than the screen (555 px at 568 × 320): the title, the countdown and three links stack in one column below M.
The photos are Figma's moodboard, several with other roasters' packs: to replace before launch.
